column1: # lesson — lessons that opt out of the local runner's namespace hardening.
# After init, the local runner labels the lesson namespace with
# subject *is* Pod Security must opt out: hardening there re-applies the very
# label the learner is asked to add, silently pre-solving the check.
# Not lesson frontmatter: `labctl content push` 400s on unknown keys — a
# exactly as `cloudOnly:` would (see cloud-only.tsv and iximiuz/README.md).
# `.labctl/` is never pushed (`content push --dir courses/kubelings`), so a
# registry here cannot trip the validator.
# A frontmatter reader remains as an inert fallback in the runner, so if the
# platform ever accepts the key, migrating is a data move with no code change.
